name: accessibility-remediation-case-study
description: A real openly licensed course module (MIT OCW 9.00SC, Unit 1) audited against WCAG 2.1 AA, remediated into accessible HTML, and documented with before/after evidence, a conformance report, and a scaling prioritization model (content CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, code MIT).
notes: Pinned audit tools (playwright 1.57.0, axe-core 4.11.1, pa11y 9.0.0, lighthouse 13.0.1, dotenv 17.3.1) are resolved from the workspace root node_modules by walking up the directory tree. Nothing here is duplicated or committed. Node 18+.
